title: Consultant for Drawbridges Paint Condition Assessment
short_description: Consulting services for paint assessment and rehabilitation specifications for three Alameda drawbridges.
project_scope: Comprehensive paint condition assessment for three drawbridges in Alameda County: Park Street Bridge, Fruitvale Avenue Bridge, and High Street Bridge. The consultant must assess structural steel, auxiliary components, and bridge towers, then develop a detailed coating rehabilitation scope and prepare bid specifications for future coating works.
services: Inspection and assessment services for bridge paint/coating condition; evaluation of structural steel and bridge components; development of coating rehabilitation scope; preparation of bid specifications for future rehabilitation works; related civil and structural engineering support.
relevance_explanation:

- Includes structural steel assessment and future rehabilitation scoping, offering some technical bridge-related content.
- However, the tender is primarily for paint condition assessment and coating rehabilitation specifications, not core structural or bridge design.
- Scope is closer to inspection and maintenance consulting than innovative structural engineering.
- No major spans, structural interventions, or complex design tasks are described.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender notice. Useful cost indicators mentioned: three existing drawbridges, structural steel and tower coating assessment, and future rehabilitation scope development.
